description: This file declares classes related to media pipeline capabilities, including a factory class for creating media pipeline capabilities and a class representing the capabilities of a media pipeline, with methods to query supported MIME types and check MIME type support.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaPipelineCapabilities.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilities
classes.description: Represents the capabilities of a media pipeline, providing methods to query supported MIME types and support status.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineCapabilities
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of IMediaPipelineCapabilities.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported MIME types for a given media source type.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
